evidence.method: Independent LCW decoding of original OverlayPack and OverlayDataPack, each 32 blocks / 262144 decoded bytes. OverlayTypes IDs are zero-based enumeration order, not the INI numeric keys. Decoded by effects teammate; no original game implementation copied.

X.placement: Place one entire native sprite per longitudinal X cell at tile(x, bridgeOriginY+1), never once per lane. Use the selected template's derived deck-plane anchor (90,35) relative to the projected tile top vertex; the original canvas-center convention (90,45) is retained separately as nativeCanvasCenterAnchor.

Y.placement: Place one entire native sprite per longitudinal Y cell at tile(bridgeOriginX+1,y), never once per lane. Use the selected template's derived deck-plane anchor (90,35) relative to the projected tile top vertex; the original canvas-center convention (90,45) is retained separately as nativeCanvasCenterAnchor.
